rows.Kwic: 曰：三點如流水，曲似刈禾鎌。師後居伏牛山，上堂曰：即心即佛是無病求藥句，非心非佛是藥病對治句。僧問：如何是脫灑底句？師曰：伏牛山下古今傳。示滅於隨州開元寺。京兆興善

Override.AttributionNote: 五燈嚴統(第1卷-第9卷). Record of the Orthodox Lineage of the Dharma Transmission (傳法正宗記), Funiu Zizai section. Funiu Zizai is the exact hall speaker who classifies 'this mind is buddha' as a medicine-seeking-without-illness phrase and 'not mind, not buddha' as a medicine-and-illness counteractive phrase.
